paper.title: Performance of the MACE-MP-0 potential for calculating viscosity in LiF molten salt.

result.summary: 本文用分子动力学模拟研究了熔融 LiF 的粘度，比较了 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势与经典 Buckingham、Born-Huggins-Mayer 势的表现 [S2.p1][S3.p1]。作者使用 Green-Kubo 方法从应力自相关函数计算粘度，并与实验值对比 [S2.p1][S2.p3]。结果显示 MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在液相范围内较好地重现实验粘度，而经典势预测的粘度存在温度轴上的偏移 [S3.p1]。作者还通过从晶体结构逐步加热模拟熔点，发现 MACE 得到的熔点明显更接近 LiF 的实验熔点 [S3.p2]。原文指出，这些结果表明 MACE 势产生的动力学对准确模拟该体系是必要的，并有助于指导其他熔盐体系的专用势开发 [S4.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：经典原子模型（Buckingham 和 BHM 势）在生成熔融 LiF 的忠实热物理数据方面存在不足，其预测的粘度在温度轴上存在明显偏移 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者希望借助快速发展的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs），特别是 MACE-MP-0，来改进对熔融 LiF 的分子动力学描述，并报告其计算粘度与实验数据的吻合程度 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: this understanding is hindered by a poor theoretical understanding of the liquid state, and the inadequacy of classical atomistic models in generating faithful thermophysical data.
the Buckingham potential model of molten LiF predicts the viscosity at a noticeable off-set temperature.
Motivated by these applications and a desire to improve the MD picture of molten LiF we now turn to the rapidly growing field of machine-learnt interatomic potentials (MLIPs).
Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.

method.text: 作者使用经典分子动力学（DL_POLY 包，Buckingham 和 BHM 势）以及 MACE-MP-0（small）机器学习势（通过 janus-core 包）对熔融 LiF 进行模拟 [S2.p1]。粘度通过 Green-Kubo 方法从应力张量自相关函数的积分计算，并同时利用其他非对角分量 [S2.p1]。统计采集使用 NVE 系综，时间步长 1 fs，轨迹长度 1 ns，并对 20 个独立初始构型取平均；平衡过程从晶体结构在 NPT 系综中逐步加热 [S2.p2]。体系大小为 512 个原子，MACE 模拟的墙钟时间通常比经典势的 CPU 计算长约一个数量级 [S2.p3]。

evidence.quote: We perform MD simulations of molten LiF using classical MD (using the Buckingham and BHM potentials), via the DL_POLY package, and MACE MLIP, via the python package janus-core using MACE_MP_0 (small flavour).
In both cases we use the Green-Kubo method to calculate viscosity from the integral

For all statistics collection simulations we use the NVE ensemble with a timestep of 1 fs and a trajectory length of 1 ns, and average across 20 initial configurations each independently initialised with the same density.
For equilibration we heat the system in the NPT ensemble from a crystal lattice structure taking temperature steps from 10 K to the desired temperature in steps of 50 K.
In both we use a system size of N=512 atoms

the added computational complexity of the many-bodied MACE potential stills leads to a far longer simulation wall-time (typically one order of magnitude) than the CPU based DL_POLY calculations based on classical potentials.

experiments.text: 作者在熔融 LiF 体系上比较了 MACE、Buckingham 和 BHM 三种模型计算的粘度与实验粘度数据 [S3.p1]。模拟温度覆盖熔点以上的液相范围，并通过从晶体结构逐步单调加热至 1250 K 来观察体积变化以确定熔点 [S3.p2]。此外，作者在各自熔点附近（Buckingham 为 890 K，MACE 为 1147 K）计算了速度自相关函数、态密度、部分径向分布函数和结构因子，以检验结构和动力学是否合理 [S3.p4][S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We begin by comparing the viscosity measurements from the three computational models to experimental data in Figure 1.
in Figure 2 we show the system volume V for the MACE, Buckingham, and BHM models following a gradual monotonic heating from a crystal structure up to 1250 K.
We calculate these values just above the melting points in each case to compare the dynamics at the lowest temperature still consistent with the liquid state.
Next we look at the partial RDFs g(r) in Figure 4, and the structure factors derived from them in Figure 5.

findings.text: MACE 模型计算的粘度在温度轴上与实验数据吻合良好，而 Buckingham 和 BHM 模型的粘度存在已知的温度偏移，后者约在高于实验温度 300 K 处才匹配实验粘度 [S3.p1]。通过逐步加热晶体结构，MACE 模拟的熔点与实验熔点吻合良好，而经典势低估熔点约 300 K（实验值为 1121 K，也有 1143 K 的记录）[S3.p2]。在动力学方面，MACE 模拟中 Li 和 F 原子的速度自相关函数振荡频率降低，且两者出现深度相近的极小值，形状相似，表明液相运动具有更明显的类固态振荡成分 [S3.p4]。部分径向分布函数显示 MACE 的峰高略低、峰位略高，表明其模拟的配位环境比经典模型更宽 [S3.p5]。作者认为这些结果支持了经典势粘度偏移与熔点低估相关的假说，但也指出系统尺寸和缺乏界面等其他因素可能也有贡献 [S4.p2]。

evidence.quote: The results for the MACE model agree well with the experimental data across the temperature axis, unlike the known offset for the Buckingham and BHM models: the simulated viscosity matches the experimental viscosity well, albeit with the latter at a temperature around 300 K higher.
We observe good agreement between the experimental melting temperature and the melting temperature of the MACE simulation.

the poor reproduction of the experimental viscosity in simulations governed by the Buckingham and BHM models is related to the underestimation of the the melting temperature by approximately 300 K, ascertained in experiments to be 1121 K (although 1143 K is also recorded).
We see a decrease of the well known oscillatory frequency of F and particularly Li atoms in the MACE simulation.
Both Li and F atoms exhibit a much deeper minima in the MACE VAFs, approximately equal in magnitude.
deeper minima in MACE systems imply more pronounced solidlike component of the liquid motion.
the MACE peak heights slightly lower and the peak positions slightly higher than those of the classical RDFs.
The reduction in magnitude indicates a somewhat broader coordination environment simulated by the MACE model than the classical model
Our results lend some credence to that hypothesis, but it remains possible other effects such as system size and the lack of interfaces may contribute.

limitations.text: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面，以及模拟体系尺寸较小导致缺乏长波长和低频声子，因此从晶体结构逐步加热的方法可能并不普遍准确，确定熔点需要自由能计算或相共存模拟等其他方法 [S3.p3]。作者明确表示，本工作的目标和重点是输运性质（如粘度）的计算和预测，而非准确确定熔点，后者留待未来研究 [S3.p3]。此外，由于计算时间和资源的限制，使用 MACE-MP-0 无法采用更大的体系来增加计算截断半径以观察 g(r) 的进一步衰减 [S3.p5]。作者还提到，MACE 势的计算负载高于经典两体势，且通过针对熔融相 LiF 的更多训练数据可以获得更好的专用势 [S4.p1]。

evidence.quote: simulated systems often employ periodic boundary conditions and hence have no free surfaces or interfaces, present experimentally, which promote melting.
Another factor is the small system sizes in MD simulations compared to experiments.

gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point and other methods such as calculating the free energies of solid and liquid phases, simulating phase co-existence and so on can be used instead.

the goal and emphasis of this work is the calculation and prediction of transport properties such as viscosity rather than determining the melting point accurately which is a task for future investigations.

In order to increase the calculation cutoff radius and see the peaks reduce further and the g(r) tend to 1 we would need a larger system. For the computational time and power we have available this is not practical with MACE-MP-0.
The MACE potential is able to more accurately reproduce experimental properties of molten LiF, but at the cost of an increased computational load versus classical two-body potentials.
with better results obtainable from a dedicated potential with more training data specific to the molten phase of LiF.
